summary: Comprehensive frontend Playwright testing of Egypt package detail page (/afrika/aegypten/luxor-strand-urlaub) at desktop 1440 and real mobile 390 emulation. 70 assertions covering header/stats/trust row, price card (INR + 8 services with icons, no toggle), expert quote clamp/expand, itinerary tabs (5 tabs A-E with correct names/day labels), route text toggle, accommodation CTA text, activities per tab (3/4/3/3/2), Optional badge, desktop scroll button, glance section (initial no days -> summary CTA reveals 5 day rows with correct font hierarchy, hide + readmore toggles), ratings row (Google 4.7 / TripAdvisor 4.9), sticky bar with 'From ₹1,44,000' + 'per person' (no 'p.p.'), fonts (Instrument Sans/Serif, Bricolage Grotesque), no green rgb(0,109,68), no Trustpilot text/img, no '$', mobile no horizontal overflow, mobile experts card visible with '33+ hours' and horizontal-scrollable activities track, listing regression. ALL 70 assertions passed with 0 console errors on both detail and listing pages.
critical_code_review_comments: EgyptDetail.jsx is ~315 lines and still readable, but Head/PriceCard/ExpertCard/ExpertsCard/Glance/Recommended/Steps/StickyBar could be split into components/egypt/detail/* for maintainability if page grows further.
Stat card background color rgb(251,234,219) is hardcoded; consider a Tailwind theme token (e.g. brand-peach) for consistency across pages.
In StickyBar the price row structure repeats markup from PriceCard; extract a shared <PriceInline/> to keep INR formatting/label in one place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All spec assertions in review_request pass. Detail page uses data-testid throughout. If future changes are made, re-run the same script; note that eg-activities-desktop-scroll requires clicking a tab that has >1 activity before testing scrollLeft.
